name: Suzumori Miyuki
source:
The young wife of the protagonist's colleague. Full-time housewife. She is a shy person while also being not very strong-minded and is easily pushed around.

She has been married for about three years to her husband. Just as we were discussing the possibility of having children, her husband became very busy. They have been having sex less and less often, and have been without each other for the past six months now. She is not able to actively seek out her own needs and is unaware that she is sexually frustrated.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1139459]Getchu[/url]]
